mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS totalAssignments, COUNT(asub.id) AS submittedAssignments, SUM(CASE WHEN asub.is_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateSubmissions FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN assignment_submissions asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id AND asub.student_id = #{studentId} WHERE a.course_id = #{courseId} AND a.due_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)

SELECT asub.id, asub.student_id, asub.submission_date, u.name AS student_name, a.title AS assignment_title FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN users u ON asub.student_id = u.id WHERE a.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY asub.submission_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT asub.id, asub.student_id, asub.score, asub.submission_date AS updated_at, u.name AS student_name, a.title AS assignment_title FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id JOIN users u ON asub.student_id = u.id WHERE a.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND CAST(asub.graded AS UNSIGNED) = 1 ORDER BY asub.submission_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MAX(daily_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS daily_count FROM assignment_submissions asub JOIN assignments a ON asub.assignment_id = a.id WHERE a.teacher_id = #{teacherId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(asub.submission_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ) AS daily_counts
